verdict: Paid ads are dark; Google Business profiles are your only active channel.
narrative: In the last 28 days, zero dollars were spent on Meta or Google Ads, meaning no paid lead engine was running this period. Your Google Business profiles remained visible — 963 combined impressions across three locations over 25 days — but activity dropped sharply in the last three days of the window, a pattern being investigated now. Two of your three profiles recorded zero calls despite generating hundreds of impressions, pointing to a call button or tracking issue that is suppressing direct contact; that is being diagnosed and corrected this week. Once the call tracking is repaired, the true volume of inbound interest from those profiles will be visible.
